newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIAN CASTOR DOWN ON FRESH SUPPLY, LIGHT DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: INDIAN CASTOR DOWN ON FRESH SUPPLY, LIGHT DEMAND.

text.p: Indian castorseed September delivery dropped three to four rupees to 1,166 rupees per quintal on fresh speculative offerings, traders said.
They said poor overseas demand and higher supplies depressed market sentiment after last week's uptrend.
Daily average arrivals of castorseed in the western Indian Gujarat region were 10,000/12,000 bags (75 kg each).
Traders said there were no deals in December deliveries due to lack of interest among market players.
"We are concentrating only on September delivery at the moment," one trader said.
Groundnut oil fell one to two rupees to 375 rupees per 10 kg on higher arrivals and with demand resistance at higher level, traders said.
In Rajkot, groundnut oil fell to 586/587 rupees per 15 kg from 590 rupees.
In Bombay, imported palm oil fell one to two rupees to 258/259 rupees per 10 kg on expectation of fresh arrivals and on a fall in world prices.
Traders said the overall market sentiment for oils and oilseeds was weak on reports of progress of monsoon in the producing centres.
